# AI Agents & Configuration

## 1. Overview
This file defines the configuration, roles, and instructions for AI coding agents (such as GitHub Copilot, custom LLM agents, or automated coding assistants) interacting with this project repository.

## 2. Agent Guidelines & Rules
* *Code Standards:* AI agents must adhere to clean code practices, maintain consistent project structure, and follow the established backend/frontend patterns.
* *Testing:* Any new code or feature generated by an agent should include or be accompanied by corresponding unit/integration tests to ensure stability.
* *Review Process:* All agent-generated suggestions and modifications must undergo manual code review and local testing before being committed to the main branch.

## 3. Scope of Assistance
* Assisting with boilerplate generation, debugging errors, and suggesting optimizations for API endpoints or UI components.
* Maintaining documentation consistency across the docs/ directory
